observations.source: Recognizable squat wrecked blue-gray car with four tires, broad chassis/body, roof, raised bent hood, four jagged side-window openings, bumper and loose rubbish. N/S read clearly as a car; E/W expose a long blank rectangular roof/hood/trunk chain. Broad planar slabs dominate; wheel arches, door segmentation and crafted body transitions are weak.
observations.target: Rounded roof and fenders, defined doors and lower trim, inset window rims and rims/tires yield a more deliberate toy-car construction. Useful native volume improvements should matter more than matching the original box part counts.

observations.source: Muted pale blue-gray body, dark cyan cabin, near-black charcoal tires, tiny dull brown rust/debris. The large monochrome panels and dark lower band feel cold and flat.
observations.target: Same blue family with warm tan/orange localized rust and warm gray metal. Warm contrast should stay selective; the wreck should not become an orange car.

observations.source: Faceted symmetric source rig leaves broad flat surfaces, grain at enlarged native resolution and very dark tires/undercarriage.

observations.source: Windows are opaque jagged blue geometry around dark openings, not alpha holes. Sill rust is a tiny brown rectangle. Wheels have simple low-sided hub discs.
observations.target: Purposeful chipped paint/rust at seams and edges, bent panels, substantial window frames, tire shoulders and hub definition can express discarded condition without screen-space painted noise. Exact mirror/wiper/trim/rust count is optional.

observations.source: At55px/cell the 3-cell car remains recognizable, but fine handles/rust disappear and tires merge into dark backgrounds. E/W read more as anonymous flat blocks.

observations.source: Small dark triangular gaps beside cabin/window rims and dark horizontal cavities read as seams; undercarriage and tires can become black dead areas. Car is intentionally damaged, so coherent dark openings are identity, not defects.
observations.target: No pinholes, coplanar flicker, construction seams, clipped loose pieces, disappearing material faces or bright alpha halos across required views and phases. Intentional cabin darkness must remain bounded by readable frames.
